steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each score is placed by its group size against the minimum of five and whether a sample is stated.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 score is reported for a group below five

findings.title: Score reported for a group below five
findings.fix: Merge the group or withhold the score

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] readiness-team-b.csv:12  Score reported for a group below five.
       Fix: Merge the group or withhold the score.
[medium] scores.csv:19  Result with no sample size.
       Fix: Add the sample size.
[low] group-sizes.csv:26  Score not aggregated.
       Fix: Aggregate the score.
Not checked: Survey design quality.
pros: Checks a score reported for a group below the minimum size (default 5), and a result reported with no sample size.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-readiness-survey-analysis skill on the records for this review.
